title: Pure Traptrix
summary: Traptrix cards with their 'Hole' Normal Traps, generic Insect and Plant Extra Deck monsters, and staples. Traptrix monsters are unaffected by Hole Normal Traps, and Link-1 Traptrix Sera turns every Normal Trap or Traptrix monster activation into a free card from the Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Traptrix Mantis searches any Traptrix monster on Normal Summon and bounces + re-Sets a Set Spell/Trap as a Quick Effect; Traptrix Myrmeleo searches any 'Hole' Normal Trap on Normal Summon and destroys a Spell/Trap when Special Summoned.
Traptrix Pudica searches Traptrip Garden on Normal Summon and temporarily banishes an opponent's Special Summoned monster when Special Summoned.

Traptrix Arachnocampa Special Summons itself from the hand as a Quick Effect during the Main Phase while you control a Traptrix monster (locking Extra Deck summons to Insects and Plants for the turn) and protects Set cards in your Spell & Trap Zone from being destroyed once per turn.

summary.title: Opening: Traptrix Pudica (or Mantis) + Any Normal Trap
steps: Normal Summon Traptrix Pudica to search Traptrip Garden, then Link Summon Link-1 Traptrix Sera using Pudica.

Set and activate Traptrix Holeutea by discarding a Normal Trap to Special Summon Holeutea as a Level 4 monster; Traptrix Sera triggers twice— first setting a Hole Normal Trap from the Deck when a Normal Trap resolves, and then Special Summoning Traptrix Myrmeleo or Dionaea from the Deck when a Traptrix monster effect activates.

Overlay the two Level 4 monsters into Rank 4 Traptrix Pinguicula (to search Traptrix Arachnocampa) or Traptrix Rafflesia, and use Traptrip Garden for an extra Normal Summon or banish Holeutea from the GY to revive Pudica on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Traptrix Sera & Holeutea Engine
summary.text: Link-1 Traptrix Sera is unaffected by Trap effects and has two independent triggers: whenever a Normal Trap Card is activated, she Special Summons a Traptrix monster with a different name from your Deck; whenever another Traptrix monster's effect is activated, she Sets a Hole Normal Trap directly from your Deck. Traptrix Holeutea activates the turn it is Set by discarding a Normal Trap to become a Level 4 Plant monster (firing Sera immediately), and banishes itself from the GY as a Quick Effect to revive a Traptrix (such as Myrmeleo for a Spell/Trap pop or Pudica for a monster banish).

summary.title: Extra Deck Control & Finisher
points: Traptrix Rafflesia makes all other Traptrix monsters you control indestructible by battle and card effects and untargetable, and detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to send a Hole Normal Trap from your Deck to the GY and apply its effect.

Traptrix Pinguicula detaches 1 material to search any Traptrix monster and attaches opponent's monsters sent to the GY or banished by card effects as Xyz Material; Traptrix Atypus boosts your Traptrix monsters by 1000 ATK while a Normal Trap is in the GY, negates face-up opponent's cards up to the number of Insects and Plants you control, and destroys 1 of those negated cards.

Traptrix Allomerus, Traptrix Cularia, Baromet the Sacred Sheep Shrub, Benghalancer the Resurgent, and Seraphim Papillion provide additional Plant/Insect recursion and removal within Arachnocampa's lock.

summary.title: Spells & Hole Normal Traps
points: Traptrip Garden grants an extra Traptrix Normal Summon, prevents the first battle destruction of your Insects/Plants each turn, and banishes a monster you control to Special Summon a Traptrix from the hand or GY.

Bottomless Trap Hole, Time-Space Trap Hole, Gravedigger's Trap Hole (which stops hand and GY monster effects and burns for 2000), Floodgate Trap Hole, Chain Hole, Network Trap Hole, and Traptrix Trap Hole Nightmare form a searchable toolbox for Myrmeleo, Sera, and Rafflesia.
